Groups into Single-Elimination |prizepool= |tournaments=4on4 |entrance= |website= |sdate=2000-01-21 |edate=2000-04-29 |twitch= |teamfirst=Flaming Fist |teamfirstflag=se |teamsecond=CAPSLOCK |teamsecondflag=se |teamthird=Euthanasia |teamthirdflag=se |teamthird2=Clan Malfunction |teamthird2flag=fi |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 }} == Introduction == * Round: Villains 2 - Group 1 * Match: {{Flag/se}} [[CAPSLOCK]] vs {{Flag/de}} [[Imperial Bounty Hunterz]] * Date: 2000-02-21 == Match report == === DM3 === CAPS: 121 - iBh: 121

The map was a tie and was therefor replayed.

"This map was played friday, exactly one week ago. The biggest problem was to find a server that gave equal pings. After nearly one hour of searching we succeeded with one Danish server which wasn't great for neither one of the teams but none team was given a real ping advantage. CAPS concentrated on controlling the RA right from the start, iBh spending more effort to the YA and RL area. No team was in a real advantage over the other in the first minutes. At minute 7 CAPS was able to get the YA area under their control which was held by iBh. CAPS got away with 59-40 to the 11th minute. Then iBh took YA area back, and also ran quad so CAPS' lead became smaller again. Even better for iBh, they also got RA control for the first time of the game at the same minute and were on best way locking down the map. The score waqs 66-60 to CAPS at this time but iBh being in advantage. In just three minutes they scored 30 frags and taking the lead with 90-66 to iBh. Somehow, CAPS got RA control back and also the last Pent was theirs. With 16 minutes being played the score was 104-82 to iBh but CAPS findind back into the game and scoring one frag after the next. With 30 seconds to play, iBh still lead with 5 frags. Just in the last few seconds they did the important frags to get a draw ! 121-121. Guess what ? Sure, overtime wasn't set. How could it be ? :) Damn good game to both teams ! The second attempt of the dm3 game was made directly after the first one. The game was pretty equal but about 5 minutes in the game, CAPS started to lag really badly. They had pings about 200-300 and 30% PL. iBh was gentle enough to breake the game although they didn't need to nor were they forced to do so by CAPS. We've been waiting on the server for about one hour when i remember correctly, in hope that CAPS' ping would get better. It didn't. So the game was rescheduled for the friday of next week (today)." -Andy === DM3-2 === CAPS: 119 - iBh: 95
[[Image:Caps-ibh-dm3.jpg]]
Rematch.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/d/d8/Ibh-caps--dm3--slop.qwz sLoP (iBh)]

"This game started with the same problem like the first one did: finding a server. Again, there was no server which gave good AND equal pings to both teams. It was a Danish server again which gave a higher ping to iBh's players but a higher PL to CAPS' players. The game's style was also likely to the first one. No one really in control of the map, CAPS locating more to the RA and iBh to the YA+RL area. iBh had a tiny lead in the first minutes until minute 6 when the score was 32-32. CAPS took over their first lead in the game then and getting a few frags. The 2nd Pent was taken by CAPS and so was the Quad. They used it for getting the YA+RL area under their control and they succeeded. One minute later iBh controlled RA though and comming back into the game. The game has slightly changed because iBh controlled RA and CAPS had RL+YA but iBh got CAPS' lead decreased down to 109-85. In the last minute iBh had completely control over the map and CAPS' players were hiding in water, at SNG and all where a good place to hide is.. The final score was 119-95 to CAPS. Both teams played well again but CAPS just having the luckier end." -Andy === DM2 === CAPS: 160 - iBh: 138
[[Image:Caps-ibh-dm2.jpg]]
Map pick by End of Days.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/d/d7/Ibh-caps--dm2--slop.qwz sLoP (iBh)]

"The server was changed to some other Danish server. iBh pings decrease a bit, CAPS' PL was the same but their ping got a bit worse. CAPS tried to do a quadladder at start but they failed. iBh got the first RL and Quad and quickly had YA under their control. CAPS players were quickly getting armored and weaponed at Rl room though and iBh's quad control was fading away. After 4 minutes, CAPS held YA tele and Quad and they could increase their lead to 79-35 at minute 8. iBh didn't give up, getting important locations back but they only were able to decrease CAPS' lead. With 15 minutes being played the score already was 128-77 which seemed pretty unreachable. The last 2 minutes were nearly the same like on dm3. iBh had total control over the map and CAPS' players just died and didn't press fire to get around the counter. CAPS succeeded and finally beat iBh with 160-138." -Andy == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags ** CAPS: 279 ** iBh: 233 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
